_doc.what: Hand-curated returns of people (soldiers and civilians) between Russia and Ukraine: exchanges of prisoners and one-way releases. NOT a scrape: this file is edited by hand. See scripts/pow_exchanges/README.md.

fields.date: Day of the return (YYYY-MM-DD). A deal carried out over several days is one record per stage.
fields.kind: exchange | release (one-way: e.g. the seriously wounded handed over outside an exchange).
fields.ua_received: People returned to Ukraine, soldiers and civilians, as Ukraine's Coordination HQ for POWs posts it (t.me/Koord_shtab). Where Ukraine gave no count, Russia's 'взамен переданы N' — ua_reported_by says so. null = no figure known (not 0).
fields.ua_received_civilians: Of ua_received, civilians — when stated; null otherwise.
fields.ru_received: People returned to Russia, as the Russian MoD posts it (t.me/mod_russia): servicemen plus any civilians it lists. null = no figure known.
fields.ru_received_civilians: Of ru_received, civilians — when stated; null otherwise.
fields.deal: The agreement a stage belongs to (Istanbul 2025, Geneva 2026, …); null for a standalone exchange.
fields.mediator: Mediator named in the announcement, when one is.
fields.backfill: From Sept 2022 every Ukrainian figure is from the Coordination HQ channel, every Russian one from the MoD channel (read via the Telegram API). Mar–Jun 2022, before the HQ channel: Deputy PM Vereshchuk's and GUR's Telegram posts for Ukraine's figures, Russian officials via Interfax / RIA for Russia's. No exchanges took place in July–August 2022.
fields.koord_number: The Coordination HQ's own running count ('76-й обмін'), when a post states it. Several days of one exchange share a number.
fields.status: confirmed (both sides' figures) | partial (one side's figure missing) | discrepancy (sources disagree on a stored figure; see notes).
fields.sources[]: { via, url, published_at, covers, quote } — quote is verbatim (ellipses mark cuts); covers lists the figures the source supports ('date' = it only attests the exchange took place).

todo: June–July 2025 Istanbul stages: neither side gave a count per stage.

Mar–Jun 2022: on 2022-06-22 Vereshchuk counted 14 exchanges and 408 people returned (ArmyInform); the 12 sourced here up to 2022-06-18 sum to 377, so ~2 small exchanges (~31 people) are missing. Russia's figures are missing for most of them.

The Coordination HQ called 2022-12-31 its 35th exchange, but Kommersant numbered 2022-06-28 the 12th and GUR said 'over 20' by 2022-10-12 — the HQ's count likely includes other returns (bodies, one-way releases).
